text: {"bull":["Polycab’s FY26 revenue reached ₹28,884 cr, up 29% YoY, the highest in its history.","Operating profit for FY26 rose to ₹4,013 cr, a 35% increase from ₹2,492 cr in FY25.","Net profit for FY26 climbed to ₹2,708 cr, a 32% YoY jump, with PAT margins at 9.4% in FY26.","The company’s net cash position stood at ₹39.9 billion in Q1 FY27, indicating a strong liquidity buffer.","Operating profit margin for Q1 FY27 was 13.8%, up 70 bps sequentially, reflecting improved profitability.","Wires & Cables segment grew 39% YoY in Q1 FY27, while FMEG grew 71% YoY, showing robust double‑digit expansion."],"bear":["Operating profit margin dipped to 13% in Q4 FY26, lower than the 15% in Q1 FY26, indicating margin pressure.","Net profit for Q1 FY27 was ₹7,967 million, a 33% YoY increase, but PAT margin was only 9.7%, below the 13.9% margin in Q4 FY26.","The company’s working capital cycle improved to 15 days in Q1 FY27 but is expected to rise to 45‑50 days as temporary factors normalize.","Capital expenditure in Q1 FY27 was ₹3.2 billion, higher than the ₹3.9 billion in Q4 FY26, potentially impacting free cash flow.","FMEG’s EBIT margin in Q1 FY27 was 8%, lower than the 13.1% margin in Q4 FY26, suggesting margin compression in that segment.","The company’s dividend yield is only 0.56%, indicating limited shareholder return relative to peers."]}
